A_lineup: Character concept line-up sheet: FIVE distinct people: 1) the eldest, a lean woman in her sixties with a shaved head and a prayer-cord round her wrist, calm and upright; 2) a broad-shouldered man in his forties, bald, hollow-cheeked; 3) a young woman in her twenties with short cropped dark hair; 4) a wiry older man with a grey stubble scalp, stooped; 5) a teenage boy, small and thin, clutching his own arms. Standing side by side in a row, full body, straight on, all at true human scale. Direction A, AS WRITTEN: captives first. Grey sackcloth shifts gone to rags, bare dirty feet, gaunt faces, shaved or cropped heads, knotted prayer-cords round wrists, one hides a small silver medallion on a cord, scratched devotional tally marks on forearms. Muted grey and bone colours. Rendered in the same art style as the style references: chunky stylized PBR game character art, grimdark, worn and grimy, soft studio light, plain light grey background, no text, no labels. Humans, not dwarves: normal human height and proportions, thin from captivity. No gore, no wounds beyond grime and faint bruising, no beards on the women.
